responsible_organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
description: Dados amostrais de compras contendo fornecedores produtos e projetos aos quais os produtos se relacionam
limitations: Dataset amostral e sintetico para testes; nao representa uma cadeia de suprimentos real. Arquivo oficial inspecionado nas Fases D1-D3 e checksum conferido.

source_name: TED Search API, XML Notices and TED Open Data Service
responsible_organization: Publications Office of the European Union
description: Fonte oficial de avisos de contratacao publica da UE. A API de busca anonima seleciona avisos; o XML oficial preserva a estrutura e o TED Open Data Service oferece RDF/SPARQL.
limitations: API de busca retorna campos potencialmente achatados e nao deve ser a unica fonte para relacoes; XML eForms e TED Schema coexistem desde 2022. O subset D4 restringe-se a eForms Result notices.

source_name: Contract Awards in Investment Project Financing (Since FY 2020)
description: Official World Bank IPF contract awards dataset sourced from STEP; 288036 rows and 21 columns reported on 2026-08-19; daily updates; global coverage since FY2020.
limitations: Borrower-entered data; supplier country is registration place; excludes subcontractors and cofinancing; joint-venture value is split equally; Procurement Group does not guarantee completeness or accuracy.
